lede: Georgia carries the stronger underlying team rating — +9.9 against +5.7, a 4.2-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Alabama -1.9 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Alabama winning 55% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is pass defense, where Georgia leads Alabama by 108 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
